diff:
A tmp/check.py
A tmp/sapi.ps1
A tmp/verify.py

--- tmp/check.py ---
import sys
print(sys.version)
mods = ["pyttsx3", "gtts", "edge_tts", "speech", "pydub", "numpy", "wave", "sapi"]
for m in mods:
    try:
        __import__(m)
        print("OK", m)
    except Exception as e:
        print("NO", m, type(e).__name__)

--- tmp/sapi.ps1 ---
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Speech
$synth = New-Object System.Speech.Synthesis.SpeechSynthesizer
$text = "Welcome aboard the evening ferry, please keep your bags clear of the doors."
$out = "<WORKSPACE>\announcement.wav"
$synth.SetOutputToWaveFile($out)
$synth.Speak($text)
$synth.Dispose()
Write-Host "done"

--- tmp/verify.py ---
import wave
w = wave.open(r"<WORKSPACE>\announcement.wav")
n = w.getnframes()
fr = w.getframerate()
print("channels", w.getnchannels(), "rate", fr, "frames", n, "duration_s", round(n/fr, 2))
